focused_checks.assessment: Calibration and appropriate contact conditions are required; stable readings and skin sensations are not direct equilibrium/energy measurements. The unchanged $5\sim8$ token is attributed to the original example, explicitly not current medical advice or a universal waiting time.
A lid is not insulation. Melting and warming depend on ambient temperature and heat supply; isolation does not imply an initially equilibrated state.

Equal temperature/no temperature-driven net heat flow are distinguished from full constrained equilibrium. Net phase/reaction progress is distinguished from microscopic equilibrium exchange; rigid partitions may maintain unequal pressures.
Constant readings/temperature do not establish equilibrium; driven heating/cooling steady states are explicitly distinguished.
Hot-to-cold spontaneous net heat flow is qualified as undriven thermal contact, not all energy transfer. Sealing matter and preventing heat transfer are correctly separated.

Reference zero is not zero motion/energy. Fixed-point conditions and calibration are stated; t/T, fixed offset and equal-sized Celsius/kelvin intervals are consistent. Celsius readings are not proportional mean-energy measures; no new equation or numeric constant is introduced.

Limited to classical nonrelativistic equilibrium, center-of-mass translation relative to bulk motion, and absolute temperature. Equal mean translational energies do not imply equal speeds, instantaneous energies, arbitrary-phase total kinetic energies, or equal rotational/vibrational energies.
